reason: The picture links these signals to muscle genes, so applying them to unspecialized cells is a clear way to pursue the muscle goal.
expectation: The signals should guide some cells toward becoming muscle cells.

alternatives.reason: That pairing also follows the pictured signals and would pursue the supporting-cell goal.

effect: The muscle signals produced young cells that use muscle genes, but they do not yet contain the fibre bundles.
reaction: The picture makes it clear that the cells still have more developing to do.
reason: The supporting-cell signals are pictured acting on another group of unspecialized cells, so this directly pursues the other goal.
expectation: The signals should guide some cells toward becoming supporting cells.

alternatives.reason: The young muscle cells may use the building blocks to make muscle proteins.

effect: The supporting signals made young cells using support-protein genes, but they do not yet have a surrounding fibre network.
reaction: The parallel with the young muscle cells is clear.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, so they may help the young muscle cells make muscle proteins.
expectation: The cells should use the building blocks to make muscle proteins.

alternatives.reason: Those cells may also need building blocks to make their supporting fibres.

effect: The amino acids helped the young muscle cells develop growing bundles of muscle proteins, completing that goal.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the predicted protein bundles appear.
reason: Supporting fibres are also proteins, so the young supporting cells may use the same building blocks to make them.
expectation: The supporting cells should develop and make surrounding fibres.

effect: The supporting cells became connective tissue, with fibres released around them. That completed the second goal and showed a contrast with proteins kept inside developing muscle cells.
reaction: The inside-versus-outside contrast made the two outcomes easier to understand.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making both kinds of cells and supplying their protein building blocks was worthwhile: it showed how cells with the same DNA can take different paths and produce different structures.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two signal combinations felt a little repetitive, although the parallel helped make the comparison clear.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that supporting cells release protein to build material around themselves, while the developing muscle cells contain bundles inside.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt especially arbitrary: the signal pictures named their targets, and amino acids were identified as protein building blocks. The exact way the signals activate different genes was not explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see how these developing cells and supporting material become larger body structures. The comparison was clear, though the repeated pairings made the decisions fairly straightforward.
